checks: Consumer regression; controlled props; focus/keyboard; portals/scroll lock; desktop/mobile and error/empty states.
Deep link/reload, back/forward, guards, redirects, old URLs, query/hash and menu navigation.
Request/response/error contract; nullable data; pagination; cache invalidation; cancellation and retry idempotency.
Server authorization; cross-user/tenant denial; expired session/logout; no stale private cache or client secret exposure.
Confirm database ownership before changes; migration/backfill/rollback, transactions, locking/indexes and isolated test data; no production mutation without authorization.
Unmount cleanup, abort/races, stale closure, duplicate events, StrictMode and idempotent mutation behavior.
Existing locale keys, long labels, pluralization, locale/timezone/number formatting and fallback language.
Keyboard, focus restoration, accessible names/roles, disabled states and semantic contrast tokens.
Baseline vs changed render/request counts, large lists, bundle/client JS; no speculative memoization.
Dependency source/version/license, lockfile, lifecycle scripts, runtime/build/CI compatibility; no blind latest or global installs.
Identify destination and explicit authorization for uploads, billing, notifications, production data, publishing or deployment; tool access alone grants no permission.
